attempts.cause: Generated section bookmark sequence was not reset between multiBuild passes, making TOC keys unstable.

attempts.error: ReportLab paragraph parser encountered crossed emphasis/font tags
attempts.cause: Asterisk multiplication inside backtick code spans was interpreted as Markdown emphasis across equation text.
attempts.remedy: Shield code spans before emphasis processing, restore their escaped literal contents afterward, and limit single-asterisk emphasis to tight word-boundary spans.
